title: Tehran comes out as the 'winner' of the initial US - Iran deal
summary: The US and Iran have signed an agreement paving the way to an end of the war between the two countries and starting a 60-day negotiating clock to reach a final deal. Although US President Donald Trump has hailed the deal a success, it has been met with criticism as many denounce concessions made to Tehran. FRANCE 24's Philip Turle tells us more.
